provenance: S4 reference model + S2 v0.2.3 planner reference + S1 v0.1.1 backend model (bench profile, FIXTURE_NOT_OFFICIAL protocol)

scenarios.name: a_happy
scenarios.description: mode A, DRY_RUN: object 1 selected, delivered, back home

scenarios.name: a_line_happy
scenarios.description: mode A, LINE with TX->RX loopback feedback: arrival + feedback checks active; vision through the PS register VISION_SIM

scenarios.name: a_cancel_approach
scenarios.description: FIST_CANCEL during approach (STOP_ON_CANCEL): pause, clear, move back part-way, retrace to HOME

scenarios.name: a_cancel_holding
scenarios.description: FIST_CANCEL during lift (holding, no STOP flag): finish the segment, retrace, re-open the gripper at the grasp pose, back HOME

scenarios.name: a_palm_timeout
scenarios.description: no PALM_READY at PRE_DELIVERY: palm-wait timeout = cancel, object returned to its slot

scenarios.name: a_blind_timeout
scenarios.description: blind window shorter than the delivery move: stopped during DELIVER, no release, back to PRE_DELIVERY, then palm-wait timeout and return to slot

scenarios.name: a_fault_estop
scenarios.description: e-stop/motion-permission input drops during approach: FAULT, permission revoked, planner ESTOP, no further motion

scenarios.name: a_fault_comm
scenarios.description: LINE: feedback stops during lift: COMM_TIMEOUT fault, permission revoked (S1 then latches ESTOP_EVENT)

scenarios.name: a_fault_planner
scenarios.description: segment exceeds the configured planner VMAX of channel 1: planner validation ERROR -> PLANNER_ERROR fault before any sample

scenarios.name: a_refuse_not_home
scenarios.description: planner LAST_DELIVERED is not HOME: task refused, no motion

scenarios.name: a_ps_write_blocked
scenarios.description: PS writes planner CONTROL=ESTOP and S1 MODE=OFF during the task: both dropped and flagged, task completes

scenarios.name: b_happy
scenarios.description: mode B: SELECTED, PS commits a 5-segment path, delivered, back home

scenarios.name: b_cancel_hold
scenarios.description: mode B, HOLD policy: FIST_CANCEL while holding -> stop and HALT, then PS RELEASE

scenarios.name: a_fault_recover
scenarios.description: fault (ABORT during approach), PS RELEASE + FAULT_CLEAR, planner back HOME manually, ENABLE, second task completes

scenarios.name: a_fault_s1_limit
scenarios.description: object 3 approach to a keypoint outside the S1 soft limit (inside the S4 joint limits): the unchanged S1 latches LIMIT_VIOLATION, S4 -> S1_FAULT

scenarios.name: a_fault_arrival
scenarios.description: LINE: feedback stops during lift, arrival timeout shorter than the comm timeout: ARRIVAL_TIMEOUT fault

limitations: vectors prove RTL == reference model on bench data, not behaviour on a real arm
